# Website build

This repository holds the built, static website and nothing else. GitHub Pages serves it.

- `dist/` is the complete site, as generated by the build.
- `.github/workflows/pages.yml` deploys `dist/` to GitHub Pages on every push to `main`.

**Do not edit this repository by hand.** It is generated: every publish replaces its whole history with a single commit holding the current build, so any change made here is lost on the next publish. The commit message names the source commit the build was made from.

The source code lives in a separate, private repository. Make changes there and publish again.
